## Round 69 — BUILDER (R68 spec item 3) + play-tester

**Ships:** the `sChamp trail` printed lane on the C1 stats line — a VIEW over the ledger's receipted sFit rows (`tail(8)`), never a separate state array. Opens at ≥2 points; crosses load boundaries (the loaded ledger re-anchors the file's rows). Printed, never asserted as a learning claim.

**Pin:** `tests/r69-schamp-trail-glue.test.js` — 3 tests on verbatim page fns. FAIL-first on pristine tip (git stash): T1/T2 2/2 RED. Post-fix 3/3 GREEN.

**Suite:** 301 tests, 293 pass / 0 fail / 8 honest env skips; qa 8/8; README 309=301+8 live-verified; prerun canonical md5s byte-unchanged; conflict-scan OK (102 files).

**Key finding (P2):** the v1 tag does not reproduce ITSELF — three draws, three different L1/L2 (root cause: v1 `core.js:55-56` raw `Math.random()` in the swan path; seeded at R3 0722670). Every v1-era baseline number is a draw of a distribution, not a point. R70 spec carries the annotation mandate with the root cause.

Stacked on playtest-round-68 (PR #85, Casey-gated). PLAYLOG R69 entry + canonical index row included.
title: Round 69: d(sChamp)/d(gen) printed lane on the C1 stats line (R68 spec item 3)
